topic: Characterization of Antibiotic Biosynthesis Genes in Soil Bacteria
llm_query: Hi. I want to create a dataset with a metadata table for data generated from the genomic analysis of biosynthetic gene clusters in soil-derived bacteria. We will isolate bacterial strains from soil samples, sequence their genomes, and identify biosynthetic gene clusters responsible for antibiotic production. Each cluster's genomic location will be mapped, and gene-level annotations will be performed to determine the function of individual genes within the clusters. Additionally, we will chemically characterize the antibiotics synthesized by these genes. The data is intended to identify novel antibiotic compounds and understand the genetic basis for their biosynthesis.

topic: Genetic Basis of Alkaloid Production in Medicinal Plants
llm_query: Hi. I want to create a dataset with a metadata table for data generated from the study of biosynthetic pathways in medicinal plants that produce alkaloids. We will sequence the genomes of selected plant species, focusing on identifying and annotating biosynthetic gene clusters that lead to alkaloid production. This will involve mapping the genomic loci of these clusters and annotating the genes involved in the pathway. We will also conduct experiments to chemically characterize the alkaloids produced. The data is intended to elucidate the genetic and biochemical pathways plants use to synthesize medically important alkaloids.

topic: Fungal Biosynthetic Gene Clusters for Secondary Metabolite Production
llm_query: Hi. I want to create a dataset with a metadata table for data generated from the exploration of biosynthetic gene clusters in fungi that produce secondary metabolites. We will extract fungal DNA, perform whole-genome sequencing, and search for clusters of genes involved in the synthesis of secondary metabolites. Each cluster will be annotated at the gene level to understand the individual roles within the biosynthetic pathway. We will also isolate and chemically analyze the secondary metabolites produced by these fungi. The data is intended to discover new secondary metabolites with potential industrial applications and understand the genetic architecture underlying their biosynthesis.
